claim: On S5 state tracking, holonomy of operators that satisfy the group's relations is exact at L=40 and 160; commuting (diagonal) holonomy is capped by letter counts; noncommuting operators that satisfy no relations score at chance.
limits: G1 as registered FAILED at L=10: the centroid readout cannot name a class absent from training (3 of 2000 words, seed 2). One group, one readout, x86_64 only. A lookup table is exact everywhere: no advantage over classical computation. The expressivity result is prior work (Merrill, Petty & Sabharwal 2024).
